rationale: The papers provide new insights into the atmospheric dynamics and heat redistribution of the specific exoplanets in question. For example, 2606.12116 and 2409.16270 explore atmospheric models and feedback mechanisms for 55 Cancri e, while 2404.17658 and 2609.10719 investigate atmospheric properties and phase curve mapping for HD 149026b and WASP-43b, respectively. These studies contribute substantive evidence but do not fully resolve the discrepancies in thermal phase curves and heat redistribution efficiency.
